system.description:
The war-song tradition of the Red Waste tribes and their allies at Treaty Hold: epic verse, battle cries and histories of the dead carried in memory, because paper doesn't survive the desert.

  • Reshapes: your Exalt.
  • War Poem: once a round, when an ally under your Exalt hits with a weapon, it rolls the weapon's damage dice twice and keeps the higher roll.
    • 9th level: on every weapon hit.
  • Oral Historian: Advantage on Bardic Lore checks on oral histories, lineages, tribal politics and old wars.
